final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT rm.ordervault, u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT rm.ordervault) AS n FROM riskandmargin AS rm JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = rm.ordervault JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink GROUP BY rm.ordervault, u.acctscope), step2 AS (SELECT acctscope, SUM(n) AS scope_sum FROM step1 GROUP BY acctscope), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(scope_sum) AS total_sum FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.acctscope, s2.scope_sum, 1.0 * s2.scope_sum / s3.total_sum AS ratio FROM step2 AS s2 CROSS JOIN step3 AS s3), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step4) SELECT s4.acctscope, s4.scope_sum, s4.ratio, 1.0 * s4.scope_sum / s5.avg_ratio AS result FROM step4 AS s4 CROSS JOIN step5 AS s5
